name: Edge Runtime Orchestration
purpose: Compose perception, calibration, tracking, forecasting and the conflict engine into one deterministic per-frame safety cycle, resolve which shift manifest governs a camera, and provide the offline demo pipeline used when no camera is configured.

public_interfaces.name: SentinelEdgeRuntime.process_frame
public_interfaces.contract: One frame in, one telemetry packet out: detections, metric tracks, zones, forecast status, events and latency. Deterministic for identical input; unused subsystems degrade to a labelled status instead of raising.

public_interfaces.name: SentinelEdgeRuntime.conflict_engine (live envelope ingestion)
public_interfaces.contract: Shift manifests compiled by the agentic layer can be injected at runtime without restarting the worker.

public_interfaces.name: resolve_manifest / active_manifest_path
public_interfaces.contract: Camera -> governing shift manifest resolution by site; an unmatched camera gets an explicit default, never another site's envelopes.

acceptance_criteria: A single frame produces a complete packet with an explicit latency measurement.
A missing detector, checkpoint or calibration produces a status field, not an exception.
Injected exclusion envelopes change the evaluation on the next frame without a restart.
The data/manifests handoff stays writable by the agentic layer and readable here.
risks: This project is the integration point, so it imports almost everything: it is the first place a boundary break shows up.
Runtime envelope injection is stateful; concurrent writers (agent + operator) need the documented ownership rule.
